title: Veggie omelette with cheese
summary: Low in carbs, big on protein.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper. Slice the mushrooms and pepper and grate the cheese.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and soften the mushrooms and pepper for 4 to 5 minutes. Add the spinach and stir until it wilts.
Spread the vegetables out, turn the heat to medium-low and pour over the eggs. Draw the edges in with a spatula so the runny egg flows underneath.
When the top is nearly set, after 2 to 3 minutes, sprinkle over the cheese, fold the omelette in half and slide it onto a plate.
